title: Sum of Digits
statement:
A library gives every book a long number as its code. To catch typing mistakes, the librarian checks the **sum of the digits** of each code.

Given a non-negative integer **n**, print the sum of its decimal digits.
output: Print one integer: the sum of the digits of n.
hints: `n % 10` is the last digit and `n / 10` (integer division) removes it.
n can be up to 10^18, so use a 64-bit type. You can also read n as a string and add up the characters.
editorial:
Repeat while n > 0: add `n % 10` to the answer and divide n by 10. For n = 0 the answer is 0. Use `long long` because n does not fit in 32 bits. Reading the number as a string and adding `c - '0'` for every character works just as well.

Complexity: O(number of digits).
